title: Costa Group enters new ownership phase as experienced consortium takes control
summary: Costa's announcement of 26 February 2024 that a consortium of Paine Schwartz Partners, Driscoll's, Inc. and British Columbia Investment Management Corporation has taken control at A$3.20 per share, with Harry Debney as interim chief executive. The release notes the company's origins with the Costa family in Geelong, Victoria in the late 1800s and a history of more than 120 years, and states that Costa launched a record four new blueberry varieties during 2023.
why_it_matters: Driscoll's, itself a blueberry breeder and licensor, becoming a part-owner of Costa, another blueberry breeder and licensor, links two breeding programmes through ownership rather than through a licence. That is a materially different kind of connection and is easy to miss if only licensing relationships are tracked.

reading.rationale: A structural link between two competing breeding programmes.

commercial_position.rationale: Changes how Costa and Driscoll's should be treated relative to each other.

monitoring.rationale: Completed transaction; watch for operational integration.
